description: Learn Filipino Tongits through short lessons, focused drills, and private practice against bots. See public bot actions, select cards on a mobile-friendly table, and review visible cards from private or completed hands. Explore a sourced Philippine variant guide with clearly marked rule differences and gaps; practice uses Crazy Tongits training rules, not every listed variant. Search curated source summaries for Crazy Tongits, Tongits Go, Tongits Star, and Tongits ZingPlay, keeping each brand and platform separate. Rule lessons support English, Filipino, and Taglish; brand source summaries are currently in English. Our goal is to make Tongits easier to understand for Filipino players through practical, evidence-based learning. No live account access, live human-match move advice, hidden-card guesses, wagering, or redeemable rewards. Independent research about other brands does not imply affiliation or official support.

defaultPrompt: Teach me Tongits with a short interactive practice hand.
Compare Tongits Joker with Butasan Joker without mixing their rules.
